rationale: C25 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both letters transmit legislation amending and extending an established federal program, warn that statutory authority or programs will expire on June 30 without congressional action, justify continuation through national-security and public-welfare needs, and then describe the proposed extensions and program changes. This combination is more concrete than the generic legislative-transmittal language shared with several other candidates. C20 is strongly related in subject and package context but chiefly supplies higher-education content that the child expressly treats as complementary legislation. C02 shares the HEW legislative-transmittal and enclosure formula but offers less distinctive substantive machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Almost all of the programs of the National Defense Education Act will terminate on June 30, 30. Steps should be taken immediately to make provision for the continuation and expansion of these programs.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Without this legislation, authority under that Act would expire on June 30 of this year. The proposed bill authorizes additional obligations for a period of 5 years
shared_material.explanation: Both identify a June 30 statutory expiration and use it as the immediate reason for legislation continuing and extending an existing federal program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith draft legislation to amend, improve and extend the National Defense Education Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith for consideration by the Congress a draft of legislation to amend the Federal Airport Act.
shared_material.explanation: The operative transmittal sentences are closely parallel and concern amendments to named established Acts.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Our national strength and welfare demand a strong and balanced educational system.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Continuing the program of Federal assistance to airports is essential to our national security, passenger safety, and economic growth.
shared_material.explanation: Each links continuation of the expiring program to national security and broader national welfare or growth.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I recommend that the student loan, fellowship, language and statistical improvement programs be made permanent. Equipment grants...should be extended for three years
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The bill has six major features: 1. The bill provides for a 5-year extension of the Federal Airport Act
shared_material.explanation: Both move from the expiration-and-need rationale to a component-by-component account of extensions and modifications.
